title: Riglane Gate Result (Side-Channel File, v2 per-branch ledger)
description: Schema for gate-result.json — the v2 merged ledger. A parallel step fires the gate hook once PER BRANCH, so several processes write one file: each writer upserts ONLY its branch under the shared file lock, verdict fields merge by freshness (validated_at), loop_count is monotonic, and the top-level aggregate is recomputed on every write. Written by the riglane gate-check hook AND the engine-inline gate; read by step_collect_result. Ephemeral (cleared at step_begin) — no v1 migration; a v1-shaped document is replaced, never merged.

step.description: Step name this ledger belongs to. step_collect_result MUST verify this matches the expected step before consuming the result; ledgerForStep refuses to merge across steps.

run_token.description: Manifest's run_token at time of writing (UUID4). step_collect_result MUST compare this against manifest.run_token to detect stale results from previous runs/sessions; ledgerForStep refuses to merge across runs.

schema.description: Ledger schema discriminator. ledgerForStep replaces (never merges) any document without it.

branches.description: Per-branch records for a parallel step, keyed by branch index as a string. EMPTY object for a non-parallel step (the writer sets the top-level verdict directly).

loop_count.description: Monotonic in-session retry count for THIS branch — max(existing, incoming), outside freshness, so a stampeding zero-count writer can never erase retry history.

validated_at.description: ISO local-offset timestamp of the validation that produced this record. Freshness anchor: a strictly older observation never replaces a newer verdict.

passed.description: Aggregate verdict. Non-parallel: the step's verdict. Parallel: all-pass or PARTIAL failure => true (partial keeps succeeded branches' work); only catastrophic all-fail => false.

failed_branches.description: Indices of failed branches (empty for non-parallel or all-pass). Recomputed on every write.

checks.description: Total structural checks. Parallel: sum over branches.

failures.description: Failed checks. Parallel: sum over branches.

details.description: Failure descriptions. Parallel: per-branch details prefixed with '[branch N] '.

loop_count.description: Gate retry iteration. Non-parallel: the step's retry count. Parallel: max over branches.

branch_results.description: Legacy per-branch mirror derived from `branches` on every recompute (parallel only) — retained for pre-v2 consumers until they migrate.

source.description: Top-level writer marker — stamped ONLY by the engine-inline writer, so step_collect_result can distinguish its own earlier artifact from a hook verdict. Absent on hook writes = trusted.
